newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Dec 19.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Thursday's edition of The Wall Street Journal:
- Bonds continued to show weakness Wednesday as the market absorbed $18.25 billion in new notes from the Treasury.
- Shares of Lewis Galoob Toys have lost nearly half their value since mid-November, as news has spread that its most important toy, the flying doll called Sky Dancer, is losing altitude.
- Western Resources made a hostile $2.8 billion bid for home alarm provider ADT.
- Entergy agreed to acquire London Electricity for about $2.1 billion.
- British Airways offered to sell its 24.6 percent stake in USAir back to USAir.
- Pfizer and Warner-Lambert won approval to begin their joint marketing effort for a new "statin" drug that dramatically lowers cholesterol.
- Zenith said it would lay off nearly 1,200 workers, or 25 percent of its U.S. work force.
- WMX Technologies said it would sell its 19.5 percent stake in Wessex Water for about $299 million, resulting in a charge of about $88 million.
- ABC was ordered by a Florida jury to pay $10 million to a Miami financier who argued he was libelled by the network's "20/20" program.
- CSX is expected to announce it is raising the value of its $8.64 billion stock and cash offer for Conrail.
- Biogen 's Avonex has caught, or even overtaken, a rival multiple-sclerosis drug marketed by Schering after only seven months on the market.
- A CPA group proposed a rule to standardize how companies account for software expenses in a potential windfall for many companies.
- Avenor agreed to buy Repap for stock valued at more than $586.6 million, plus $1.76 billion in debt assumption.
- The SEC's top mutual fund official urged vigilance and reform in a recent speech about the fund industry despite its biggest year ever.
- Boeing 's plan to buy McDonnell Douglas could face resistance from EU regulators.
- Technology stocks surged, pushing major indexes higher.
